# Fonts

The popup's two typefaces ([ADR 0048](../../docs/adr/0048-tekst-popup.md)), vendored
unchanged and installed by `make install` to `share/fonts/torchlight`. The popup
falls back to Ubuntu Sans or Cantarell, and to Ubuntu Sans Mono, when they are
missing.

| Directory | Font | Version | Source | License |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `schibsted-grotesk/` | Schibsted Grotesk (variable, wght 400–900) | 1.0 (Google Fonts, 2023) | https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/schibstedgrotesk | SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`OFL.txt`) |
| `bedstead/` | Bedstead, regular | 3.261 | https://bjh21.me.uk/bedstead/ | Public domain (CC0 1.0) |
